name: isambard
description: AI-powered Discord bot with persistent memory using DynamoDB

scripts.sst-deploy: if [ -z "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" ]; then op run --env-file=.env.op -- bunx sst deploy; else bunx sst deploy; fi
scripts.sst-dev: if [ -z "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" ]; then op run --env-file=.env.op -- bunx sst dev; else bunx sst dev; fi
scripts.sst-diagnostics: sh -c 'if [ -z "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" ]; then op run --env-file=.env.op -- bunx sst diagnostic --print-logs "$@"; else bunx sst diagnostics --print-logs "$@"; fi' _
scripts.sst-remove: if [ -z "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" ]; then op run --env-file=.env.op -- bunx sst remove; else bunx sst remove; fi
